jobs.title: Senior Process Improvement Analyst (Hybrid)
jobs.location: New York, NY or Edgewood, Long Island — hybrid
jobs.why: Direct match for process discovery, stakeholder interviews, current/future-state mapping, Excel analysis, workflow automation, testing and rollout; posting accepts 2–4 years of related analysis/operations experience and does not require prior fintech expertise.
jobs.gap: Senior title; executive-facing transformation, formal process-mapping artifacts and quantified benefits at enterprise scale need strong examples. Lean/Six Sigma is preferred, not required.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst

Current posting found through reputable third-party listing; original employer application page not independently confirmed.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY — hybrid, 4–5 days per week onsite
